newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - June 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - June 16.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Arabia rejects U.S. vote on Jerusalem.
- Islamic Development Bank signs cooperation agreement with Arab Agricultural Development Organisation to boost cooperation between them.

- Defence lawyers of two British nurses accused of killing an Australian colleague in Saudi Arabia convince a panel of Saudi judges to request a copy of the victim's will in an effort to discount her brother's role in the trial.
- U.S. defence secretary William Cohen, currently visiting Gulf Arab states, meets Saudi King Fahd.
- National Gypsum Company to test production of its new plant in Yanbu, built at a cost of 140 million riyals, in July.
- International Agricultural Development Fund says Saudi Arabia offered $70.6 billion in assistance and loans to 72 countries by 1995.
